finding: All 9 neural over-2 catalogue nodes are SNAP class (ARA<1) once computed from membrane biophysics. Old >2 values were orientation/rung mismatches.

HH Spike.method: HH 1952 integration, I=10 uA/cm^2 sustained, velocity-Verlet-free explicit Euler dt=5us

Refractory.method: Single HH spike; release=thr->peak, accumulation=Na inactivation h-gate recovery to 0.9*rest

Pyramidal 10Hz.method: Cited: AP half-width ~1 ms (Bean 2007); ISI=100 ms at 10 Hz; release/recharge

FS Interneuron.method: Cited: PV+ FS half-width ~0.3 ms (Bean 2007), ~200 Hz; release/recharge

AMPA EPSP.method: Biexponential AMPA: rise=build (0.5 ms), decay=release (3 ms); ARA=rise/decay

GABA IPSP.method: Biexponential GABA_A: rise=build (1 ms), decay=release (6 ms); ARA=rise/decay

Ca2+ Spike.method: L-type Ca2+ plateau ~100 ms (cardiac/dendritic), upstroke ~2 ms; release/plateau

Thalamic Burst.method: T-type LTS envelope ~40 ms, crowning Na spikelet ~1 ms; release/LTS
